INNER-PAGE TEMPLATES — separate from the homepage canvas so version history stays clean.

All words are verbatim from the live site (full-site harvest). The schedule grid holds all 86 real classes with times aligned across the week — the filter chips work, click them. The Jiu-Jitsu page carries the full live-page copy, the real BJJ class times per day, and Head Coach Bryan Tidwell's real photo and bio.

Preserved as-is per the copy lock (flagging, not fixing): Friday 11:30 AM class ends "12:30 AM" on the live site, and the site mixes "Gi / No-Gi / No Gi" spellings. Say the word and we'll list every one for the client.

The Program Detail layout is the stamp for all 13 program pages. Still to design: coaches index, FAQ, about, contact, reviews — all content is already harvested.
